title: Chapter 1446 - 1: Lin Yuan'S First Tribulation

Chapter 1446 - 1: Lin Yuan'S First Tribulation

Chapter 1446 - 1: Lin Yuan's First Tribulation

Chaos Void.

Amid the restless speculations of time beings like Lord Mo Xu, a figure materialized in the distance.

It was Lin Yuan.

After refining the entire Chaos Void, Lin Yuan slightly sensed the changes in the whole dimension space.

He then sent an avatar to meet with Lord Mo Xu and other time beings.

After all, at this moment, the time beings like Lord Mo Xu must be filled with questions.

Why did Lin Yuan become a Time Lord so quickly?

"Milky Way!"

"Milky Way!"

Lord Mo Xu, Zhu Yin, and other time beings immediately looked at Lin Yuan.

"I know what you are thinking and worrying about."

Lin Yuan looked at the time beings, shook his head, and said, "Many things cannot be explained in a short time, you only need to know that I was born from the Chaos Void."

In the eyes of time beings like Lord Mo Xu, Lin Yuan's speed of growth seemed too fantastical, was he a 'vessel' nurtured by some terrifying being, and so on.

"Understood."

The time beings like Lord Mo Xu felt assured.

They wholeheartedly believed Lin Yuan's words.

After all, with Lin Yuan's current means of refining the entire Chaos Void, there was no need to lie to them.

Even the strongest, like Lord Mo Xu, was merely a First Realm time being, and had no ability to resist a Third Realm lord.

Their concerns were put to rest.

Lord Mo Xu curiously asked, "Milky Way, what does it feel like to be a Third Realm lord?"

The time beings who have lived through dozens, hundreds of cycles of great destruction might have encountered Time Lords.

But time beings like Lord Mo Xu, who have not yet experienced a full cycle of great destruction, have only heard about Time Lords.

They only know that Time Lords should never be provoked.

"The essence of life has become much stronger." Lin Yuan explained, "And one's own timeline has completed convergence, leaving no weak period from this time on."

"No weak period?" Lord Mo Xu, Zhu Yin, and other time beings appeared envious.

Time beings below the Third Realm always have flaws in their past, and the simplest way for lords to completely kill time beings is to go to the past and kill them.

Lin Yuan said.

Having refined the entire Chaos Void, this dimension space was under Lin Yuan's control, whether it was past or future.

"You needn't worry, the past of the entire Chaos Void is under my gaze; no lord can take action in the past time of Chaos Void."

Lin Yuan said.

Having refined the entire Chaos Void, this dimension space was under Lin Yuan's control, whether it was past or future.

Which means, since the time beings like Lord Mo Xu were born from the Chaos Void, their past in the Chaos Void is equivalent to being under Lin Yuan's protection.

Lin Yuan even had a feeling, as his strength increased, he could completely extract the Chaos Void from the timeline, making it so that time beings of the past and future could not observe the Chaos Void from the timeline.

"Thank you, Milky Way."

The time beings like Lord Mo Xu exchanged a glance and felt joy in their hearts.

Doesn't this mean that when they venture outside in the future, they need not worry about threats from other lords?

"I heard there's a lord stationed in this dimensional gap region, and this lord is named 'Lord Chu Wei'." Zhu Yin couldn't help saying, "Even though you've just entered the Third Realm, your strength shouldn't be any weaker than 'Lord Chu Wei', right?"

The time beings like Lord Mo Xu and Zhu Yin have only heard of the fame of 'Lord Chu Wei', but have never met directly.

However, with Lin Yuan's past performance, when he first entered the First Realm, he was already enough to battle with the Second Realm's Gray Ancestor, and now that he has entered the Third Realm, he should not be much weaker than the long-established lord 'Lord Chu Wei'.

"Lord Chu Wei, huh..." Lin Yuan's gaze was profound, looking in one direction, and the moment he mentioned the four characters of Lord Chu Wei, Lin Yuan established a shallow causal relationship with this lord, and along this causal line, all major true forms, numerous avatars, and various life-saving measures of Lord Chu Wei were under Lin Yuan's watch.

With just a thought from Lin Yuan, all traces of this senior Time Lord in the current timeline would be forcibly erased. Although using methods from the past, Lord Chu Wei wouldn't completely die, but it would take endless years to recover.

"I should be a bit stronger than Lord Chu Wei."

Lin Yuan said with a smile.

"A bit stronger?"

The time beings like Lord Mo Xu were shaken in their hearts.

They knew Lin Yuan very well, he never said anything he wasn't confident about; since he said he was a bit stronger, then that renowned Lord Chu Wei was really not as good as Lin Yuan.

...

While chatting with time beings like Lord Mo Xu.

Lin Yuan's true self began to elevate his consciousness, attempting to contact the will of the Supreme Rule Dao.

"Endless tribulations..."

Lin Yuan was quite curious about this path of transcendence, as it was the only one where the end could be seen.

Therefore.

After stepping into the Third Realm and becoming a Time Lord, the first thing Lin Yuan did was to see what his first tribulation on this path of transcendence would be.

Buzz—the will of the Supreme Rule Dao descended, and the contents of Lin Yuan's first tribulation test flooded into his mind.

"Travel to the dimension space at these coordinates, and with a special purification method, re-purify this dimension space?"

Lin Yuan checked the content of his first tribulation test.

As for the special purification method, it also appeared in his mind along with the test of the first tribulation; a ordinary lord could master it with just a few years of study.

"Jin Yue dimension..."

Information about the specific intelligence of the target dimension space surfaced in Lin Yuan's mind.

The Jin Yue dimension, similar to the Milky Way dimension, belongs to the few dimension spaces that do not repel foreign life forms.

"No time limit."
